title: Clothing store in SoHo, Manhattan (no construction)
assumptions: The company already exists (Spring Street Apparel LLC). Hires staff. Moves into a space that needs no construction. Puts up an exterior sign.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Certificate of Authority (sales tax vendor registration)
items.agency: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
items.note: Register at least 20 days before beginning business.

items.name: Employer registration for unemployment insurance (NYS-100)
items.agency: New York State Department of Labor
items.note: Once $300 or more in wages is paid in a quarter; FEIN needed first.

items.name: Workers' compensation and disability/PFL coverage
items.agency: New York State Workers' Compensation Board
items.condition: Insurance bought from a carrier, not a filing.

items.name: Certificate of Occupancy
items.condition: The space's existing CO must allow retail use.

items.name: Sign permit
items.condition: Signs that are nailed, screwed or illuminated.

items.name: Commercial Rent Tax registration
items.condition: Manhattan south of 96th Street above the rent threshold.

order.why: FEIN needed before the UI registration.

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
mustNotInclude.why: A store that sells no food needs no food permit.
